self.text: Hey, I’m Cal, a late‑twenties Spanish design student who loves playing chess online in my spare time. I’m a language learner, so I practice speaking English and Spanish in casual chats or structured conversations. My work sessions are quiet—complete silence while I focus on design sketches or editing. I don’t give or receive tutoring; I just enjoy learning new skills on my own. I’m flexible with how we connect: we can meet in person or switch to an online format. I’m free to chat or collaborate on Saturday mornings, Sunday mornings, or during weekday evenings. When I’m not designing, I enjoy a relaxed mood and a quiet coffee shop near my studio, where I can play a few chess moves before diving back into work. I’m looking to share this calm, focused vibe with someone who appreciates a steady pace and a clear, step‑by‑step approach to projects and conversation.
